commands:
cd aimarket-provider
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' -r check-requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python configure_provider.py

cd aimarket-provider
npm install
npm run configure
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r check-requirements.txt

npm test
npm run validate
.venv/bin/python check_local.py > report.json

cd aimarket-consumer
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python -m unittest -v

cd aimarket-consumer
npm install
npm test
